descriptionChirho: A proper name borne by at least two individuals in the Hebrew Bible: (1) a son of Reuben (Gen 46:9, Exod 6:14) and (2) a son of Perez and grandson of Judah, ancestor of David (Gen 46:12, Ruth 4:18-19); also used as a place name for a town in southern Judah. Transliterated uniformly: Spanish 'Hesron/Jetsron,' Arabic حصرون (Hasrun), Korean 헤스론 (Heseuron), Hindi हेस्रोन (Hesron), Swahili 'Hesroni.' The three clusters are the same proper noun in different syntactic slots — standalone, with lamed preposition, and with conjunctive waw — all a single onomastic entry.
